RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 14, 2005/Agrahayana 23, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Import of pepper
*301. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government allowed pepper
import from other countries and if so, how
many nations have been allowed free trade
of pepper with our country;
(b) whether the pepper of Vietnam has
been routed to India through Sri Lanka by
misusing free trade import facilities and if
so, whether Government initiated any steps
to check the misuse of trading provisions;
and
(c) whether Government propose to set
up any limitation for the import policy to
check the misuse of the concerned
provisions?
Export of cash crops
*302. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details on the export of cash
crops, particularly cashew nut and import
of cashew kernels in India for each of the
last three years;
(b) whether Government have taken
any steps to modernize the industry by
introducing new technology;
(c) if so, details thereof; and
(d) the steps proposed to increase
export of cash crops?
Construction of dwellings under IAY
in Punjab
*303. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of dwellings constructed
in Punjab under Indira Awaas Yojana during
2004-05 against the target fixed; and
(b) the dwelling units likely to be
constructed during 2005-06?
SEZs established in the country
*304. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:

94
(a) the State-wise details of SEZs
established so far;
(b) what are the advantages of
establishing the SEZs; and
(c) how many of these SEZs have been
established in backward regions of the
country?
Steps to improve balance of trade with
ASEAN
*305. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that steep import
tariffs slapped by Association of South East
Asian Nations (ASEAN) have been
disturbing India’s trade balance with them;
(b) if so, details thereof and reasons
therefor; and
(c) steps being taken to improve the
balance of trade with ASEAN?
Jehanabad Jail attack
†*306. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ:
SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA:
 Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating on formulating any joint
policy with Nepal to combat maoists after
the incident committed by naxalites in
Jehanabad;
(b) if so, the steps taken so far in this
regard; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Black-listing of NGOs
*307. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT   be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have black-
listed several Non-Governmental
Organizations due to their involvement in
corrupt practices;
(b) if so, the names of such banned
NGOs, till date;
(c) what are the details of Government
amount siphoned off by these NGOs; and
(d) whether Government propose to
tighten the guidelines for grant of financial
assistance to NGOs and if not, reasons
therefor?
Rape cases with minors in Delhi
*308. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that rape cases
with minor girls are on the increase in the
country during these days;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof
for the last three months;
(c) whether it is also a fact that more
than sufficient time is taken by the court to
punish the defaulters; and
(d) if so, the instructions to be issued
for taking decision at the earliest in such
cases and by when such instructions are
expected to be issued?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

95
States lagging behind in the PMGSY
*309. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT   be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 15 States are
lagging behind in the ‘Pradhan Mantri Gram
Sadak Yojana’;
(b) if so, which are the States and the
year from which they have not claimed their
share of funds from the Central
Government; and
(c) why such lapses were not detected
during this period through annual review
meetings held from time to time?
Provisions in the Armed Forces
Tribunal
*310. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the proposed Armed Forces
Tribunal will address the inherent blatant
deficiency in military law i.e. the absence
of remedy of appeal against the order of
the court martials;
(b) whether the existing court martial
system under military law is regulated by
mere power of military command rather
than law;
(c) whether the western nations have
upgraded their military justice system at
par with civilian criminal justice system in
the light of emerging changes in human
rights standards; and
(d) whether Government will consider
formulating a comprehensive common code
of justice/discipline for all the three forces,
separating the Judge Advocate General
branch from the command control?
Development and promotion of
handloom
*311. SHRI T.R. ZELIANG:  Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of targets fixed for
development and promotion of handloom
in the country in the last three years;
(b) whether the fixed targets have been
achieved by Government;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Threat of terrorist-attacks on tourist
destinations
*312. SHRI ANAND SHARMA:  Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to threat of terrorist attacks on
popular tourist destinations and resorts in
the country; and
(b) if so, the steps taken to ensure
security of such resorts to ensure safety of
the tourists?
Doubling of bilateral trade by India
and America
†*313. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to the
failure of most of the world-level talks under
World Trade Organisation, India and
America have decided to double the present
level of foreign trade by the year 2008 in
the bilateral talks;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

96
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the facts thereof;
(c) whether those industries where trade
is to be increased, have been identified; and
(d) if so, the names of such industries
and the target set for increasing the trade of
agricultural products?
Setting up an Inter-State Secretary
level advisory group to frame the
guidelines for NEG Act
*314. SHRI VEDPRAKASH P.
GOYAL: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government has announced the setting up
of an Inter-State Secretary level advisory
group to frame the guidelines for National
Employment Guarantee Act;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this move will bring
some transparency and how it will
function; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Plans to have Rapid Deployment
Force to protect Indian interests
*315. DR. KARAN SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether seas surrounding India are
gaining strategic importance with global
focus shifting to Indian ocean and Indian
defence planners have mooted idea of
having a Rapid Deployment Force to
protect Indian interests;
(b) whether concept framed by
Integrated Defence Staff comprising all three
services, stresses on quick movement of
troops, light and heavy weapons and
logistical support to an area of operation;
(c) whether all Chiefs of services have
examined this proposal and finally taken
its decision; and
(d) if so, what are the details of scheme
prepared and by when it is likely to be
started?
Pension to widows of freedom fighters
*316. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
many widows of freedom fighters in the
country are not getting pension;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the number of proposals received
from Punjab Government for giving pension
to the widows of freedom fighters; and
(d) the number of proposals cleared so
far and number of widows are getting
freedom pension in Punjab presently?
Separatist forces in Manipur
†*317. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
separatist forces are creating obstructions
in the functioning of local administration in
Manipur;
(b) if so, details thereof;
(c) the strategy prepared by
Government to tackle separatist forces in
the State and the main features thereof; and

97
(d) whether Government are preparing
any comprehensive plan for early solution
of this burning issue by including various
ethnic groups and political leaders of
Manipur, if so, complete details thereof?
Export growth target
*318. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether export growth target of 15
per cent fixed in this year’s foreign trade
policy has been surpassed in first half of
2005-06 with exports shooting up to $ 43.2
billion and registered a growth of 20.52 per
cent against last year’s half-yearly export
figure of $35.86 billion;
(b) whether Inter State Trade Council
had its first meeting in October-November,
2005;
(c) if so, whether Government propose
to remove export cess on export of all
agricultural and plantation commodities
levied under various commodity board acts;
and
(d) if so, to what extent Government is
expected to improve further exports during
the remaining period of current financial
year?
Strengthening the power production
and its distribution system
†*319. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the measures being taken by
Government for strengthening the system
of production of power and its distribution
in different States in the country specially
in Uttar Pradesh;
(b) whether Government have
formulated any national action plan in this
regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the progress made so far with regard
to strengthening the production of power
and its distribution system in the country?
Permission to Tobacco Board to
increase their staff strength
*320. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to
shortage of staff the Tobacco Board is
unable to set up additional tobacco auction
platforms in Andhra Pradesh despite
increased tobacco crop size in the State;
(b) if so, whether Government will
consider allowing Tobacco Board to increase
their staff strength and set up more tobacco
auction platforms with increased tobacco
handling capacity; and
(c) if so, by when?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 8th December, 2005 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 17, 1927 (Saka)

————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 14, 2005/Agrahayana 23, 1927 (Saka)

(Ministries :  Commerce  and  Industry;  Defence;  Home  Affairs;  Non-
Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —155
519
Extension of subsidy on capital loans
to coffee growers
2267. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has extended
five and three per cent interest subsidy to
small and medium coffee growers
respectively on working capital loans
through the Coffee-Boards;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government would also like
to extent the subsidy;
(d) if so, the time-frame set for this
purpose;
(e) whether Government had also
waived the old development loans and
interest amounting to Rs. 64.50 crore availed
by small coffee growers from the Coffee
Board;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) what is the total financial benefit
given to the coffee growers from the special
package?
Import of iron-scrap
2268. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
allows import of scrap iron for use in steel
plants;
(b) if so, what is the policy with regard
to import duty on import of scrap iron for
actual users in the country;
(c) what steps are proposed by
Government to ensure that leakages and
frauds are prevented in this matter; and
(d) reasons for allowing low import duty
on import of scrap iron meant for re-export,
etc?
Blacklisting of agencies issuing Pre-
Shipment Inspection Certificates
2269. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether after the last year's
explosions in and around Delhi caused by

520
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
live shells imported as scrap, DGFT black
listed a number of agencies authorised by it
to issue Pre-Shipment Inspection (PSI)
certificates;
(b) if so, the details of such companies;
(c) whether live shells are still being
imported as scrap; and
(d) if so, the stringent action being taken
or proposed to be taken in this regard by
Government?
Increase in import of agricultural
products
2270. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that import of
agricultural products has gone up during
the last two years;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) steps taken to bring down
agricultural imports?
Facilities provided to increase
export
†2271. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that economic
and other facilities are provided by
Government to the units set up in different
zones established to increase export in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) estimated value of economic facilities
provided to these units during the last three
years?
Setting up of beef industry
†2272. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have sought opinion from Ministry of
Environment and Forests regarding setting
up of beef industry by the multinational
companies in the country;
(b) if so, facts in this regard; and
(c) the reasons behind Government's
decision to consider the proposal of setting
up of beef industry in the country?
Steps for industrial promotion
2273. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what steps have been taken by
Government for industrial promotion in the
country; and
(b) what have been the results of these
steps during the last two years and the
current year so far?
Livelihood provided by retail markets
†2274. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 40 per cent
people are earning their livelihood in retail
markets as a self-employment in the
country;

521
(b) if not, estimate made by Govern-
ment in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that by
incorporating technology based system in
present retail marketing system, more
employment opportunities would be
generated with less capital investment; and
(d) if not, the facts thereof and reaction
of Government in this matter?
Turnover of retail market
†2275. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that turnover rate
of retail market in the country is constantly
increasing since last few years;
(b) if so, the average annual growth rate
of the same during last five years;
(c) whether its growth rate is required
to be increased while keeping in view the
present growth rate; and
(d) if so, the benefit likely to be accrued
as a result thereof and whether foreign
capital is necessary for increasing the annual
growth rate?
WTO deadline to EU for ending sugar
sops
2276. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
news-item which appeared in media titled
"WTO sets deadline for European Union
to end sugar sops";
(b) how it will be helpful for the Indian
exporters; and
(c) whether Government is taking
necessary action for giving due returns to
the small farmers also?
Effect of cheap imports on artisans
and craftsmen
2277. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of Muslims are artisans and craftsmen
whose products are threatened by cheap
imports from abroad;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that Chinese
silk or imported carpets and leather
products tend to throw silk weavers in
Karnataka or leather-goods makers in
Andhra Pradesh and other States out of
job;
(d) if so, the reasons identified by
Government; and
(e) the steps taken by Government to
protect such artisans and craftsmen in
Andhra Pradesh?
Issuance of licenses for import of
luxury cars
2278. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that DGFT has
issued licenses for import of luxury cars;
on the basis of fake hotel in Rajasthan;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) action taken/being taken for
investigation of the scam involved; and
(d) action proposed to be taken against
the officers found responsible for the same?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

522
Scam in exports and imports in I.T.
2279. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is over-invoicing and
under-invoicing scam with regard to exports
and imports in Information Technology
Companies with regard to our trade with
U.S.A;
(b) whether it is a fact that U.S.A. stated
that it imported software worth 1.6 billion
dollars from India for 2002-03, while India
stated that it exported software worth
6.3 billion dollars to U.S.A. during 2002-03;
(c) if so, details of measures taken by
Government to recover this huge loss of
nearly Rs. 22,000/- crores of foreign
exchange to our nation, due to this scam,
through Havala operators; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Reduction of customs duty on various
items
2280. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is planning to reduce customs duty on
various items of goods in view of the rich
nations move for abolishing farm subsidies;
and
(b) whether Government considered
that reduction in custom duty may lead to
slowdown of production in the Indian
Industry due to unfair competitions?
Change in tariff classification
2281. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact that ASEAN is
insisting on not having "Substantial
Transformation Clause" which stipulates
a four digit change in tariff classification;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a lot of
trade in Asia suffers from under-invoiced
imports;
(c) if so, how would mere value Addition
or Local Content Rule to confer origin be
considered adequate; and
(d) will Government place a White
Paper on the floor of the House on these
sensitive issues?
Foreign companies which participated
in IITF
†2282. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of foreign companies
which participated in the India International
Trade Fair organized in the Pragati Maidan
in Delhi from 14-27 November, 2005 and
the details thereof;
(b) assessment of success achieved from
the fair; and
(c) whether it is a fact that foreign stalls
were centre of attraction in comparison to
Indian stalls and if so, the reaction of
Government thereto?
Priority sector status to exporters
2283. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to give priority sector status to
exporters;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

523
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Centres opened by IIFT to train
people for SMEs
2284. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
Institute for Foreign Trade has opened
Centres to train executives for Small and
Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in specific
sectors;
(b) details of this new programme;
(c) whether it is a fact that the IIFT has
not been able to meet the demand of the
export economy for trained people in
foreign trade systems, etc.;
(d) what steps will the IIFT take to
broadbase its educational programmes all
over the country; and
(e) steps proposed to make available
education and training at IIFT to people all
over the country?
Loss to Indian exports due to
Katrina
2285. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian export has suffered
due to Hurricane Katrina in US when
shipping companies refused to accept
shipment to many US ports affected by
Katrina; and
(b) the total estimate of loss suffered in
this regard?
Steps to convert low yielding tea areas
to high yielding ones.
2286. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether two lakh hectares have been
identified as low yielding areas for tea
production;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken to make them high
yielding areas?
Three-phase implementation of
reforms to help manufacturing
sector
2287. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a suggestion
has been received by Government for three-
phase implementation of reforms to help
manufacturing sector to achieve
international competitiveness;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this calls for labour and tax
reforms etc. and flexibility in the existing
norms; and
(d) if so, action plan of Government to
address this issue?
Flaws in data relating to exports and
product classification
2288. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that data relating
to exports and product classification
(ITCHS) were found to be seriously flawed
resulting in wrong projections and
calculations;

524
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, details in this regard, including
the loss suffered on this account, sector-
wise; and
(c) what measures have been taken to
rectify the situation?
Suggestions of UNCTD
2289. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that United
Nations' Conference on Trade
Development has asked India to accelerate
the development of its manufacturing
industry instead of concentrating on IT
based services, to maintain its GDP growth;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the action plan of
Government to ensure further productivity
gains in manufacturing sector?
Production and export of flowers
†2290. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to increase the production and export of
flowers under floriculture;
(b) if so, details of the steps taken in
this regard; and
(c) the measures being taken by
Government to increase the production of
flowers in Himachal Pradesh, Uttaranchal
and Jammu and Kashmir as well as to
export them?
Withdrawal of MNF status given to
Pakistan
2291. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Pakistan has made it clear
that Most Favoured Nation status cannot
be granted to India unless Kashmir dispute
is resolved;
(b) if so, whether India would also
withdraw that status given to Pakistan; and
(c) if so, by when and if not the reasons
therefor?
Subsidy to small tea growers
2292. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details with regard to the tea leaf
processing units functioning in the country
alongwith the facilities being provided to
these units by Government;
(b) whether the small tea growers have
been seriously affected due to the steep
fall in tea prices in the country particularly
in Tamil Nadu;
(c) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the action taken by Government to mitigate
the suffering of small tea growers;
(d) whether Government proposes to
grant subsidy to the small tea growers in
the country for growing tea leaves; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Exports and imports
2293. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) details of exports to each country
during the last financial year;

525
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) details of imports from each country
during the last financial year;
(c) whether Government had set any
targets for exports and imports with each
country for the present financial year;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) present position of such exports and
imports as on date?
Target for global food trade
2294. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that though India
is one of the major food producers in the
world, it has a negligible 1 per cent share in
the global food trade;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
has fixed a target of 3 per cent by year
2015; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to achieve the target in global food
